source: MEASURED 2026-10-08: the real @elevenlabs/elevenlabs-js 2.71.0 with Node 22.22.3's real fetch against a local HTTP server, fake key (logs/stage-03/survey/probe-stream.mjs, case stream-wire; output probe-stream.out). Endpoint VERBATIM from https://elevenlabs.io/docs/api-reference/text-to-speech/stream and https://api.elevenlabs.io/openapi.json (paths./v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}/stream.post), both accessed 2026-10-08. SDK signature: api/resources/textToSpeech/client/Client.d.ts l.50.

fixture.sdkCall: client.textToSpeech.stream(voiceId, { text, modelId, outputFormat, languageCode, voiceSettings: { speed } }, { headers, abortSignal, maxRetries: 0 }).withRawResponse()

queryParams.output_format: same 21-value enum as convert; default mp3_44100_128 (openapi)
queryParams.enable_logging: boolean, default true; false = zero retention, Enterprise only (openapi)

fixture.bodyFields: Identical key set to convert (openapi Body_text_to_speech_stream vs Body_text_to_speech_full): text, model_id, language_code, voice_settings, pronunciation_dictionary_locators, seed, previous_text, next_text, previous_request_ids, next_request_ids, use_pvc_as_ivc, apply_text_normalization, apply_language_text_normalization

expect.sameAsSpeak: Everything coax sends for speak (voice id in the path, model_id, output_format query, language_code, voice_settings.speed) goes to /stream unchanged; only the path gains '/stream'.
expect.noNewRequiredField: Streaming needs no field speak does not already have.
